_doc: Company-identified one-off items (named in ODFL earnings releases / 10-Q / 10-K). Pre-tax op-level items: positive = add back (a charge); negative = remove (a benefit). disc_tax: discrete tax items, signed as ADDED to GAAP net income to reach adjusted (negative = remove a tax benefit). Gains/losses on disposal of property & equipment come from the cash-flow statement for every period and are not listed here.
